paragraphs: Lily sits with Pip and tells a story. "Today the animals play basketball at the beach," she says. The giraffe is tall. She walks to the ball. She throws it in the net. "Yes!" says the giraffe. The sand is hot and yellow. The sea is blue. Pip listens and looks at Lily.
The goat jumps on the sand. He jumps and jumps. He catches the ball. "Give it to me!" says the hippo. The hippo is big. He can't run on the sand. He walks and walks. The goat kicks the ball to him.

Then a big wave comes. The wave runs to the sea with the ball. "Oh no!" say the animals. The hippo swims and swims. He catches the ball in the water. The giraffe and the goat clap. "Woof!" says Pip. The ball is red and white. Is it a good story? "Yes," says Lily, "and now we sleep."
text.summary: Lily tells Pip a funny story. A giraffe, a goat, and a hippo play basketball at the beach, and a wave takes the ball into the sea.
